title: Realistic Gravity
description: Adds certain effects of gravity, like cobblestones falling!
body:
_Embark on a journey through a Minecraft world where gravity is not just a force but a dynamic element that shapes your gameplay experience. With the "Realistic Gravity" mod, prepare to explore a universe where your movement is influenced by the gravitational pull of your surroundings._


# Key Features:

 

## Gravity-Dependent Movement:

Experience a revolutionary approach to movement mechanics, as your vertical velocity is directly affected by your y-level. Descend rapidly when at the bottom of the world and enjoy buoyant jumps when soaring near the world's zenith. Adapt your movement strategies to leverage the unique gravitational dynamics of different y-levels and traverse the Minecraft landscape with newfound agility.

 

## Environmental Hazards:

Encounter the unpredictable consequences of realistic gravity with the introduction of gravity-induced block collapses. Stone, deepslate, granite, diorite, and andesite blocks now have a 25% chance to trigger a localized collapse when broken, resulting in a 6x6x6 area of the same block type tumbling downwards. Brace yourself for the challenge of navigating treacherous terrain as gravity's relentless pull reshapes the landscape around you.

 

## Cobbled Variants:

Discover new blocks born from the aftermath of gravity-induced collapses. "Cobbled Granite," "Cobbled Diorite," and "Cobbled Andesite" are now part of your Minecraft world, dropping from their respective parent blocks when broken. Collect these cobblestone variants and utilize them in your builds, or craft them back into their original form through smelting.

 

## Smelting Mechanic:

Harness the power of smelting to transform cobblestone variants back into their pristine, non-cobbled counterparts. Simply place the cobbled blocks into a furnace and watch as they undergo a transformation process, returning to their original state. Smelting each cobblestone variant yields valuable experience points, rewarding your resourcefulness and skillful crafting endeavors.

 

## Enhanced Dimensional Gravity:

- Nether: Experience the oppressive weight of increased gravity as you traverse the Nether. Your movement is hindered by the stronger gravitational pull, making each step feel heavier. Prepare to adapt your strategies to overcome the challenges of navigating this harsh dimension.

  

- End: In contrast to the Nether's heavy gravity, the End offers a sense of weightlessness as you explore its ethereal landscape. Experience reduced gravity that allows you to jump higher and move with greater freedom. Embrace the otherworldly atmosphere of the End as you navigate its unique gravitational dynamics.

 

# Challenge Gravity, Shape the World:

 

## Adapt to Dynamic Environments:

Adapt your gameplay strategies to contend with the ever-changing gravitational landscape of Minecraft. Navigate through precarious situations as gravity-induced collapses reshape the terrain around you, presenting new challenges and opportunities at every turn.

 

## Explore New Building Possibilities:

Explore new creative possibilities in your Minecraft builds with the introduction of cobblestone variants. Experiment with the unique textures and properties of cobbled blocks to add depth and variety to your structures, transforming ordinary landscapes into awe-inspiring creations.

 

## Master the Art of Crafting:

Master the art of crafting as you harness the power of smelting to refine cobblestone variants into their original forms. Use your newfound knowledge to optimize your resource management and unlock the full potential of the materials at your disposal.

 

## Embrace the Forces of Nature:

Prepare to embark on an unforgettable adventure through the realms of Minecraft with the "Realistic Gravity" mod. Embrace the forces of nature as you navigate through a world where gravity reigns supreme, shaping the landscape and influencing every aspect of your journey. Are you ready to defy gravity, conquer the challenges of dynamic terrain, and leave your mark on the Minecraft universe? Gravity awaits – let the adventure begin!

 

Note: Luck/bad luck affects the chances of the blocks falling.
